# How much is your UCR fee, and what does one more truck cost?

> Free UCR fee calculator for owner-operators, brokers, freight forwarders and small fleets: fee bracket by vehicle count, what one more truck costs, cost per vehicle and per mile. Editable fee table. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/ucr-fee-calculator/)
